items.title: M4 deterministic benchmark harness
items.context: Add a runnable benchmark harness for A1-A4 supported cases and B1-B15 failure injections over the existing Quantum claim-admissibility evaluator.

happy.desc: Benchmark reports all A1-A4 supported cases as expected advance/degrade outcomes with diagnostic-only metrics.

edge.desc: Benchmark metrics include unsupportedAdvanceRate, staleAcceptanceRate, boundaryViolationRate, falseStopRate, and confidence intervals without gate consumption.

adversarial.desc: All B1-B15 injected failures are blocked or degraded as expected; no production, Authority, hardware, theory, or solver-improvement claim is emitted.

items.userSees: User runs lattice quantum_claim_benchmark --json and sees "unsupportedAdvanceRate":0, "staleAcceptanceRate":0, "diagnosticOnly":true, "gateEvidence":false, "supportedCases":4, and "failureInjections":15.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke asserts A1-A4 supported cases produce expected advance/degrade outcomes, supportedCasesPassed=4/4, diagnosticOnly=true, and gateEvidence=false.
Smoke asserts unsupportedAdvanceRate, staleAcceptanceRate, boundaryViolationRate, falseStopRate, Wilson confidence intervals, writesLifecycleEvidence=false, and mutatesLifecycle=false.
Smoke asserts all B1-B15 failure injections block/repair/degrade as expected and that no production, Authority, hardware, theory, or solver-improvement claim is emitted.

items.title: M5 governance report output
items.context: Add bounded report/governance rendering that summarizes benchmark results, limitations, and ready-to-quote boundary text.

happy.desc: Report renders benchmark totals, pass rates, governance status, and limitation text in JSON and text modes.

edge.desc: Report remains diagnostic-only and explicitly marks benchmark artifacts as non-gate evidence unless a future gate consumes them.

adversarial.desc: Report refuses overclaim wording and keeps all production, Authority, hardware, theory, and solver-improvement boundary booleans false.

items.userSees: User runs lattice quantum_claim_report and sees "Quantum local diagnostic M0-M5: implemented", "Benchmark status: PASS", "diagnosticOnly: true", "gateEvidence: false", "productionClaim: false", and "authorityClaim: false".

verificationEvidence.command: node packages/main/dist/cli.js --root "$PWD" quantum_claim_report && node packages/main/dist/cli.js --root "$PWD" quantum_claim_report --json
verificationEvidence.note: CLI report renders text and JSON governance output with suiteStatus PASS, benchmark totals, pass rates, limitation text, diagnosticOnly=true, and gateEvidence=false.
Smoke asserts report artifacts are diagnostic-only, non-gate evidence, no lifecycle writes, and no lifecycle mutation unless a future gate consumes them.

Smoke asserts report boundary booleans keep productionClaim=false, authorityClaim=false, hardwareValidationClaim=false, quantumTheoryClaim=false, physicalValidationClaim=false, and solverImprovementClaim=false.

items.title: Docs and runtime status updated
items.context: Update Quantum and adapter-pack docs to state M0-M5 are implemented for the local diagnostic Quantum slice while generic global lifecycle gate integration remains out of scope.

happy.desc: Docs and runtime status say Quantum local diagnostic M0-M5 implemented.

edge.desc: Docs distinguish local Quantum M4-M5 benchmark/report completion from generic framework gate-policy adapter work.

adversarial.desc: Docs retain no quantum theory, hardware, production, Authority, solver-improvement, or broad quantum-advantage claims.

items.userSees: User opens the Quantum docs and sees "Runtime status: Quantum local diagnostic runtime status: M0-M5 implemented" plus "generic framework gate-policy adapter remains future work" and "no quantum theory, hardware, production, or Authority claim".

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:quantum-claim-admissibility && npm --prefix packages/main run test:quantum-claim-benchmark
verificationEvidence.note: Docs and runtime smoke assert Quantum local diagnostic runtime status is M0-M5 implemented and commands quantum_claim_benchmark / quantum_claim_report exist.
Docs distinguish the completed local Quantum diagnostic M4-M5 slice from the future generic framework gate-policy adapter and lifecycle integration.
Docs and smoke retain the no-overclaim boundary: no quantum theory, hardware, production, Authority, solver-improvement, external solver, or broad quantum-advantage claim.

auditLog.reason: M4 benchmark harness implemented and verified by quantum-claim-benchmark smoke plus CLI JSON output.
M5 governance report implemented and verified in text/JSON modes with boundary booleans false.
Quantum docs/runtime status updated to local diagnostic M0-M5 implemented while preserving generic framework and scientific/production/Authority boundaries.
